headline: A fresh usage reset has landed
scope: All paid ChatGPT accounts, as specified in the quoted announcement.

announcement.translation: 重置已全部生效，尽情使用吧。

previousAnnouncement.text: Global reset landing tomorrow 10am PST for all paid ChatGPT accounts. Apologies for the slow start with GPT-6.1 Sol, it's now back to running at expected speeds after the massive load spike in the first two days.
previousAnnouncement.translation: 所有付费 ChatGPT 账号将于明天 PST 上午 10 点迎来全局重置。抱歉 GPT-6.1 Sol 起初运行较慢；在前两天的负载激增后，现在已恢复到预期速度。

note: Tibo confirmed that the reset had fully propagated and quoted the earlier global-reset announcement for all paid ChatGPT accounts. The recorded time is the public confirmation post timestamp, not the exact backend completion time. The previous countdown used October 2 at 18:00 UTC under literal PST (17:00 UTC if local PDT was intended); the later confirmation post does not establish a delay.
